en.title: Please choose complaint type
en.desc1: A refund process for unsuccessful fare or top-up charges. Customer can request a refund in the event of a system disruption.
en.desc2: A refund process for penalty charges applied during incidents or commuter train delays. If customer feel the penalty was unfairly applied, they can request a review and refund of the charge.
en.desc3: A form provided for customers to submit complaints or inquiries. This form helps the customer service team manage various customer needs.
en.btn4: KITS Style ( Wallet / Card Issue / Travel & Insurance )
en.desc4: A process for reporting issues related to customer wallets or cards, such as balance discrepancies, card malfunctions, or lost/stolen cards. Customer can submit a request for investigation and resolution.

bm.title: Sila pilih jenis aduan
bm.desc1: Proses bayaran balik untuk caj tambang atau tambah nilai yang tidak berjaya. Pelanggan boleh memohon pemulangan sekiranya berlaku gangguan sistem.
bm.desc2: Proses pemulangan bagi caj penalti yang dikenakan semasa insiden atau kelewatan tren komuter. Jika pelanggan merasakan caj penalti dikenakan secara tidak adil, mereka boleh memohon semakan dan pemulangan caj tersebut.
bm.desc3: Borang yang disediakan untuk pelanggan menghantar aduan atau pertanyaan. Borang ini membantu pasukan khidmat pelanggan mengurus pelbagai keperluan pelanggan.
bm.btn4: Gaya KITS ( Isu Dompet / Kad / Pelancongan & Insurans )
bm.desc4: Proses untuk melaporkan isu berkaitan dompet atau kad pelanggan, seperti ketidaksepadanan baki, kad rosak, atau kad hilang/dicuri. Pelanggan boleh menghantar permohonan untuk siasatan dan penyelesaian.
